commit.message:
Streamable HTTP transport refactor and rust-sdk feature-parity catch-up

Streamable HTTP (from STREAMABLE_HTTP_PLAN.md):
- introduce SessionManager abstraction with LocalSessionManager (stateful)
  and NeverSessionManager (stateless) implementations
- add per-session state (LocalSession), per-request routing, SSE event
  caching for resumption via Last-Event-Id, and OneshotTransport
- restructure StreamableHttpServerTransport to a service host (not a
  Transport) that manages sessions and routes HTTP requests
- add SSE message/stream helpers and the http_test_server example

Feature-parity with rust-sdk (commits through 63583b1):
- protocol: add V_2025_11_25, bump LATEST, expose known_versions()
  (rust PR #802)
- model: add IconTheme enum and Icon.theme field (rust PR #766)
- model: add _meta to CreateElicitationResult (rust PR #792)
- service: drop the wait-for-initialized-notification gate in
  server_init.cpp so Streamable HTTP (unordered POSTs) works; the
  notification now flows through the normal handler path (rust PR #788)
- transport: add Host header validation with allowed_hosts config
  defaulting to loopback, blocking DNS-rebinding attacks against
  locally running servers (rust PR #764)

Other:
- add README.md describing the project
- add Apache-2.0 / MIT LICENSE matching the rust-sdk
